en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town nestled in a forested mountain valley. The settlement consists of early‑20th‑century villas and guesthouses with steep roofs and dormer windows, a prominent white church with a tall tower and clock, and several large spa‑like buildings scattered along the slope. Dense conifer forests cover the hillsides around the town, with open meadows higher up the valley. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
